text.p: Donnelley Enterprise Solutions Inc said Thursday it is offering 1,855,000 shares and its parent, R.R. Donnelley & Sons Co, 1,005,000 shares in an initial public offering of the company's common stock.
The stock is priced at $25 a share. The shares are trading on Nasdaq under the ticker symbol DEZI.O.

Donnelley Enterprise had been a wholly-owned subsidiary of R.R. Donnelley. The company will use the net proceeds it receives from the offering to retire all debt and advances owed to R.R. Donnelley from a June 1995 acquisition of LAN Systems Inc, and for general corporate purposes.

Underwriters are led by Salomon Brothers Inc, Montgomery Securities and J.P. Morgan & Co. R.R. Donnelley has granted the underwriters an option to purchase up to an additional 429,000 shares to cover over-allotments.

After the offering, there will be a total of five million shares of common stock of Donnelley Enterprise outstanding, with R.R. Donnelley owning 42.8 percent of that common stock. This assumes that underwriters have not exercised their over-allotment option.
